# Window test fonts

The window tests load this directory as the font directory of a machine. `latin-regular.ttf`, `latin-medium.ttf` and `latin-bold.ttf` are subsets of Inter 4.001 Regular, Medium and Bold with Latin-1, the Russian alphabet, typographic punctuation and the other characters of the UI strings; the license is in `Inter-OFL.txt`.
`cjk-regular.ttf`, `cjk-medium.ttf` and `cjk-bold.ttf` are one subset of Noto Sans SC at weight 400 with the Chinese UI strings; the license is in `NotoSansSC-OFL.txt`. Both subsets keep the name table, so the fonts are not renamed and do not use a reserved name.
